_comment: Drift guard for scripts/audit/validate-robots.mjs. Lists the AI-crawler User-agent sections that src/pages/robots.txt.ts must preserve: training crawlers are blocked from the dashboard except /llms.txt, while search/answer agents are allowed to read the full site. Captured from the live robots.txt on 2026-07-16. A MISSING entry or effective-policy change is a fail. An EXTRA entry in the live file that isn't listed here is a warn (update this snapshot to intentionally acknowledge the addition).
